The '''Zalor Militiamen''' were military [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When Zaloriis attempted to forcibly [[Zalorian Separatists|separate]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] shortly before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], under the leadership of [[Zalor Minister|Minister]] [[Transe Decar]], Zalor Militiamen engaged in [[Zaloriis campaign/Legends|battle]] with Imperial forces led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] but were soundly defeated.
